# SNode.C

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SNodeC/.github/refs/heads/main/profile/media/snodec-org-chip-dark.svg">
  <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SNodeC/.github/refs/heads/main/profile/media/snodec-org-chip-light.svg" alt="Organization · Ecosystem" width="240" height="32">
</picture>

<!-- snodec:begin status -->
[![SNode.C release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/SNodeC/snode.c?label=SNode.C&style=flat)](https://github.com/SNodeC/snode.c/releases) [![MQTTSuite release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/SNodeC/mqttsuite?label=MQTTSuite&style=flat)](https://github.com/SNodeC/mqttsuite/releases) [![Packages](https://img.shields.io/badge/Packages-signed-334155?style=flat)](https://github.com/SNodeC/Packages#banner)
<!-- snodec:end status -->

**Write the protocol. Run the messages. Ship it signed.**

SNode.C builds event-driven networking in C++. At its centre is [SNode.C](https://github.com/SNodeC/snode.c#banner), a C++20 framework for Linux; around it are MQTT and AI suites, a coding-agent workspace and signed packages for six Linux distributions.

## Products

| Project | What it is for | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **[SNode.C](https://github.com/SNodeC/snode.c#banner)** | Write networked programs and your own protocols in C++: event-driven, with HTTP, WebSocket, SSE and MQTT<br>[Quick start](https://github.com/SNodeC/snode.c#quick-start) · [Install](https://github.com/SNodeC/snode.c#install) · [Releases](https://github.com/SNodeC/snode.c/releases) | [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/SNodeC/snode.c/build-and-test.yml?branch=master&label=CI&style=flat)](https://github.com/SNodeC/snode.c/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml) |
| **[MQTTSuite](https://github.com/SNodeC/mqttsuite#banner)** | Run an MQTT broker, translate topics, bridge brokers and store messages<br>[Quick start](https://github.com/SNodeC/mqttsuite#quick-start) · [Install](https://github.com/SNodeC/mqttsuite#install) · [Releases](https://github.com/SNodeC/mqttsuite/releases) | [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/SNodeC/mqttsuite/build-and-test.yml?branch=master&label=CI&style=flat)](https://github.com/SNodeC/mqttsuite/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml) |
| **[AISuite](https://github.com/SNodeC/AISuite#banner)** | Connect applications to coding agents: asynchronous C++ and TypeScript<br>[Quick start](https://github.com/SNodeC/AISuite#quick-start) · [Install](https://github.com/SNodeC/AISuite#install) | [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/SNodeC/AISuite/build-and-test.yml?branch=master&label=CI&style=flat)](https://github.com/SNodeC/AISuite/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml) |
| **[Codex(W)UI](https://github.com/SNodeC/CodexUI#banner)** | Follow a coding agent's work in a native Qt or browser workspace<br>[Quick start](https://github.com/SNodeC/CodexUI#quick-start) · [Install](https://github.com/SNodeC/CodexUI#install) | [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/SNodeC/CodexUI/build-and-qualify.yml?branch=master&label=CI&style=flat)](https://github.com/SNodeC/CodexUI/actions/workflows/build-and-qualify.yml) |
| **[SNode.C-idp](https://github.com/SNodeC/snode.c-idp)** | SNode.C Identity Provider: OAuth2 and OpenID Connect with TOTP multi-factor authentication |  |

## Install

SNode.C and MQTTSuite are available as signed packages from [Packages](https://github.com/SNodeC/Packages#banner). Pick the guide for your installed distribution; each covers quick and custom installation, manual repository setup and updates.

| Distribution | Install guide |
| --- | --- |
| OpenWrt | [OpenWrt guide](https://github.com/SNodeC/Packages/blob/main/docs/installation/openwrt.md#banner) |
| Raspberry Pi OS | [Raspberry Pi OS guide](https://github.com/SNodeC/Packages/blob/main/docs/installation/raspberry-pi-os.md#banner) |
| Debian | [Debian guide](https://github.com/SNodeC/Packages/blob/main/docs/installation/debian.md#banner) |
| Ubuntu | [Ubuntu guide](https://github.com/SNodeC/Packages/blob/main/docs/installation/ubuntu.md#banner) |
| Rocky Linux | [Rocky Linux guide](https://github.com/SNodeC/Packages/blob/main/docs/installation/rocky-linux.md#banner) |
| Fedora | [Fedora guide](https://github.com/SNodeC/Packages/blob/main/docs/installation/fedora.md#banner) |

Supported releases, architectures and current builds: [package status](https://github.com/SNodeC/Packages/blob/main/status/README.md#banner).

## Learn

| Project | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| **[SNode.C-Book-Companion](https://github.com/SNodeC/SNode.C-Book-Companion)** | Examples, exercises and solutions for the book Layered Network Programming with SNode.C |
| **[Echo](https://github.com/SNodeC/echo)** | TCP echo server and client demonstrating SNode.C socket contexts |
| **[Websocket-echo](https://github.com/SNodeC/websocket-echo)** | WebSocket echo server, client and browser demo built on SNode.C |
| **[Talks](https://github.com/SNodeC/talks)** | Talks and slides about SNode.C |

Further example programs are listed under [More from SNode.C](#more-from-snodec).
